verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־ הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê- hā·’îš ’ă·šer lō hā·laḵ ba·‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm ū·ḇə·ḏe·reḵ ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm lō ‘ā·māḏ ū·ḇə·mō·wō·šaḇ lê·ṣîm lō yā·šāḇ
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or set foot on the path of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ḥep̄·ṣōw ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw yeh·geh yō·w·mām wā·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: But . . . his delight is in the Law of the LORD and on His law he meditates day and night

verses.original: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־ פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־ יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·‘êṣ šā·ṯūl ‘al- pal·ḡê mā·yim ’ă·šer pir·yōw yit·tên bə·‘it·tōw wə·‘ā·lê·hū lō- yib·bō·wl wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh yaṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: He is like a tree planted by streams of water yielding its fruit in season whose leaf does not wither and who prospers in all he does

verses.original: לֹא־ כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־ כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵên hā·rə·šā·‘îm kî ’im- kam·mōṣ ’ăšer- tid·də·p̄en·nū rū·aḥ
verses.literal: Not so the wicked For they are like chaff driven off by the wind

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ לֹא־ יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lō- yā·qu·mū rə·šā·‘îm bam·miš·pāṭ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the wicked will not stand in the judgment nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yō·w·ḏê·a‘ Yah·weh de·reḵ ṣad·dî·qîm wə·ḏe·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm tō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous but the way of the wicked will perish
